rows.rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only after autonomy economics and an accepted relationship clear downside and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade if regulation, insurance, incentives, disintermediation or dilution prevent trip growth from reaching per-share cash flow.
rows.thesis_summary: Uber's scaled demand, dispatch, payments, delivery, advertising and membership network supports cash generation and may distribute autonomous supply; the current plan's starter economics justify only bounded long-equity exposure because medium confidence, a material bear case, autonomy disintermediation, insurance, regulation, incentives and dilution prevent conviction treatment.
